nodes.title: Krämer geometric Fourier bounds
nodes.statement: For every vertex Λ and K-class supported on its proper Krämer stratum N_Λ, the special-divisor Euler function on nonzero labels extends uniquely to a Λ-invariant Schwartz–Bruhat function whose Fourier support has norm valuation≥−1. nodes.title: Fourier vanishing criterion
nodes.statement: Let B be a finite set of finite places of F0 and let phi be continuous, left SL2(F0)-invariant and right K-invariant, with K_v=m(varpi_v^c_v)^(-1)SL2(OF0,v)m(varpi_v^c_v) for v∈B, where m(t)=diag(t,1) belongs to GL2 and conjugates SL2, and c_v is the largest integer for which psi_v is trivial on varpi_v^(−c_v)OF0,v. requests.need: Extend the actual PEL model layer as PELModuli, Part II: represent polarized unramified, almost-dual, exotic-smooth and Krämer RZ functors with their signatures, heights, quasi-isogeny/polarization conditions; prove the stated regularity/smoothness/semistability, canonical one-dimensional lift and integral Hom-lifting ideals; construct the source-admissible RSZ global models and basic RZ uniformization, including relative/absolute exotic comparison. The current good-prime/abelian-model scope does not supply these assertions. Also construct the unitary automorphic line omega of Z §8.1, p.919, with its Petersson metric and comparison to the appropriate PEL Hodge eigenspaces. PELModuli:M6/hodge-line-bundle only supplies the determinant Hodge line; no identification is inferred. Include the special-cycle dimension theorem used in LZ Lemma 2.8.1, pp.13–14, giving codimension two for independent labels before applying Tor vanishing.

Level normalization and finite Hecke correspondences on the chosen source-admissible unitary integral model: finite étale projections for the prime-to-excluded double cosets; split Drinfeld level with CM-type matching and the unramified reflex/local-reflex extension. No arbitrary higher-level smoothness is inferred.

Tate modules of polarized OF-linear p-divisible groups, exact integral comparison and duality; the integral lifting criterion must retain its actual ramification/full-faithfulness hypotheses, not merely rational Tate comparison.

Supply the actual Dieudonné-crystal evaluations and Grothendieck–Messing deformation equivalence over nilpotent PD thickenings, with p locally nilpotent, and transport the contravariant filtration interface to the covariant convention of these sources, respecting OF actions and polarizations. R07.2 supplies the perfect-field covariant module but delegates this theorem to CR.7; the inspected CR.7 interface delegates its construction back to R07.2. Resolve this ownership loop and prove the source-specific Hom obstruction and relative/absolute ramified comparison through the PEL extension; neither perfect-field classification nor a reciprocal stage citation supplies them.

Integral Tate/Breuil comparison for the exact quasi-canonical local orders used by LZ §§4.4–4.5; state which torsion-free lattices and ramification bounds allow an integral special Hom to lift. The rank-two quasi-canonical lift-length calculation is a separate unresolved source leaf.

Etale cohomological cycle classes and Chern character with twists, localization/excision, proper trace and Poincare duality for the smooth proper unitary/exotic/symplectic strata; Frobenius equivariance and finite-extension transport. No general numerical factorization or Tate conjecture is assumed. Specific Lusztig eigenspaces/semisimplicity remain this roadmap’s proof-leaf gaps.

Schwartz–Bruhat Fourier transform for the trace-hermitian pairing, lattice indicator transform and self-dual Haar normalization; archimedean Schwartz spaces and the SL2 Heisenberg/Schrödinger model with the stated conductor.

Weil generator formulas and change-of-character/Weil-index identities with compatible self-dual measures; the local support uncertainty argument and corrected 4π Gaussian/Whittaker comparison. Fourier factors must be identified rather than absorbed into an unspecified constant.

Unitary dual-pair splitting with fixed splitting characters, standard Schwartz-to-Siegel-section map, coherent theta kernel and its admissible theta integral. gaps.title: RZ/RSZ models and canonical lifts
gaps.detail: The proposed UnitaryRapoportZinkSpacesAndRSZModels supplier is not a registered roadmap. PELModuli M6 and its good-prime deformation node do not give these ramified formal moduli spaces. The precise M6 extension request above must be accepted and source-checked, including canonical lift, Cartier Hom obstruction, regular difference divisors, Wu/Vollaard–Wedhorn stratifications and uniformization. Do not substitute an arbitrary proposition or structure for the moduli functor. The special-cycle dimension theorem (codimension two for independent labels) is part of this extension. The current R07.2/CR.7 delegation loop does not yet supply Grothendieck–Messing; the CR.7 request records the precise evaluation, nilpotent-PD hypotheses and covariant conversion needed here.

gaps.title: Nonaffine supported filtration and resolution property
gaps.detail: FK.2 supplies the regular-supported comparison only with resolution property and its product theorem only for affine formal schemes. Prove a version on the actual nonaffine RZ exhaustions, or replace each use by local arguments with descent. Inverse limits of support cokernels cannot be replaced by the cokernel of inverse limits without a separate exactness proof. U2/U9’s higher local constancy route deliberately avoids the global product assumption.

gaps.title: Quasi-canonical rank-two lifting leaves
gaps.detail: Import the marked quasi-canonical construction, quadratic level classification and degree formula from LubinTateFormalModulesAndQuasiCanonicalLifts LT.6–LT.7. That packet does not state the Gross–Keating or ramified Shi/He–Shi–Yang intersection-length formulas needed here. Request those formulas as an extension of that owner, with order/conductor, component, sign and valuation dictionaries. R07.4 supplies integral comparison, not these lengths. The LZ special-Tate-module criteria and rank-three multiplicities remain U1 targets with their stated integral-comparison leaf.

gaps.title: Specific Deligne–Lusztig cohomology leaves
gaps.detail: LZ and LL2 state the particular type-²A and type-²D Frobenius calculations they use. The underlying Lusztig results have not been read independently: acquire exact multiplicities, degrees, twists and semisimplicity before proving the boundary-generated Tate statements. Generic weights do not provide semisimplicity or all Tate classes.

gaps.title: Ramified density extension
gaps.detail: GN.3’s inspected nodes are unramified. Source-check the ramified interpolation/normal forms, the weighted extension sums and the Krämer primitive formula/vertex triangular system under the two distinct dualities. This is a GN.3 extension request, not a privately duplicated density implementation.

gaps.title: Krämer type-zero infinitesimal criterion
gaps.detail: The positive-type tangent-space argument does not prove type-zero reducedness. In the use of Lemma 3.10 with m=0, the coefficient a_(m+1) is required to be both zero and a unit, so that specialization is unavailable. Give a separate no-O/π²-point proof for the type-zero moduli functor and verify the hypotheses of the cited infinitesimal thickening criterion.

gaps.title: Krämer isolated odd-top induction repair
gaps.detail: Lemma 9.6 of the author copy has the explicit split-plane valuation counterexample in U8/kramer-main. A separate identity for this case or another well-founded invariant must close Theorem 9.7; excluding that lattice would change the theorem. The false negative-normal-norm vanishing from Theorem 8.2 is not used.

gaps.title: Arithmetic Chow/Green foundations and modularity leaves
gaps.detail: Read the Gillet–Soulé/Gillet arithmetic-current/DM theory used for products and the regularized-theta/Borcherds/Green-comparison modularity theorems. R35.1’s inspected divisor and one-cycle nodes are enough for their pairing but not for higher star products or general DM arithmetic Chow products. Arithmetic modularity in the AFL proof is restricted to F0=Q. The generic-fiber Chow constant term uses the unitary automorphic line, not an unproved identification with the determinant Hodge line; the precise PEL eigenspace/descent and Petersson-metric comparison is an additional requested leaf.

gaps.title: Siegel–Weil and archimedean normalization leaves
gaps.detail: Read Ichino §6 and the Liu/Garcia–Sankaran archimedean coefficient theorem with their range, regularization, measures, splitting characters and current convention. Derive c_K and the factor one half at infinity, rather than choosing an unspecified measure to fit the answer. Separate AFL’s repaired 4π scaling from LZ’s ASW 2π scaling. Check explicitly the Li–Liu versus Li–Zhang Whittaker parameter conversion: LL1 uses log q for q the underlying base residue size, whereas LZ uses log(q²).

gaps.detail: The proposed JacquetRallisRelativeTraceComparison supplier is not registered, and ET ordinary endoscopy does not cover it. gaps.title: AFL maximal-order and base-case source leaves
gaps.detail: Read Mihatsch’s maximal-order Corollary 9.9 with the artinian/FL hypotheses rather than weakening Proposition 3.9’s printed bound.
